department: Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences (Basic Science Division)

app_fee.value: The Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences charges a $90 non-refundable application fee for its PhD programmes, which overrides the $85 graduate-school fee.
app_fee.quote: There is a nonrefundable application fee of $90 for the PhD, MS, and Certificate programs.

fee_waiver.value: The school offers a hardship waiver only to US citizens and permanent residents, not to international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We do offer a hardship application fee waiver for our U.S. citizens/permanent residents, however we do not offer this option for our international applicants.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for the Basic Science PhD programmes, and not submitting them has no negative effect.
gre_general.quote: GRE is optional. If submitted, scores will be considered. If not submitted, no negative impact on the admissions decision.

english_waiver.value: The school's English list names US, Australian, UK, Irish, Anglophone Canadian and New Zealand degrees but not India or English-medium degrees, so the graduate-school rule does not apply here.

toefl_min.value: The school sets TOEFL minimums by programme in a table, which is not quoted here; check the application requirements page.

ielts_min.value: The school sets IELTS minimums by programme in a table, which is not quoted here; check the application requirements page.

funding.value: Full-time Basic Science PhD students receive a full tuition scholarship and a stipend or research assistantship, though the page notes some students are self-funded.
funding.quote: Full-time students enrolled in PhD programs in the Basic Science Division receive a full tuition scholarship and a stipend or research assistantship

also.quote: Self-funded students are charged an additional $6,000 per term to defray research laboratory costs.

deadline.value: The official page prints a day and month without a year (for example 'Fall: December 1 (final)'), so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: One umbrella record for the Basic Science Division: Genetics, Molecular and Cellular Biology; Immunology; Molecular Microbiology; Neuroscience (with Neuro at JAX); Mammalian Genetics at JAX. Neuroscience is listed as a separate PhD degree, so it is covered through also_fields. Clinical & Translational Science and Pharmacology are separate GSBS programmes and are not used. The GSBS deadline table is not quoted (table cells), so deadline is Not stated. Supervisor is not stated; students do three lab rotations in the first year.
